display.name: Spanmetrics Demo Dashboard
display.description: Migrated from OpenTelemetry demo 33bd823107b1b38eaa88dd4ef625cc16d60475d4. All queries use ClickHouse. Metrics preserve PromQL calculations through ClickHouse SQL; other signals read Collector tables.

spec.query:
SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['service_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics)
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['span_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE startsWith(metric_name, 'traces_span_metrics_') AND match(tags['service_name'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$'))
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

spec.text:
This dashboard uses RED metrics generated for all services by the spanmetrics connector configured in the OpenTelemetry Collector.
Chart panels may require 5 minutes after the Demo is started before rendering data.

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service,
if(has([${span_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${span_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_span_name
SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "B",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('topk(7,histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service), ', span_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_span_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(1, dateDiff('second', toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC')))), 's'), '])) by (le,service_name)))'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))

display.name: Top 7 Highest Endpoint Latencies  Mean Over Range

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service,
if(has([${span_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${span_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_span_name
SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('topk(7, sum by (span_name,service_name)(increase(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service), ', span_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_span_name), '}[5m]) / increase(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service), ',span_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_span_name), '}[5m
])))'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))

WITH if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service,
if(has([${span_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${span_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_span_name
SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('topk(7,sum by (span_name,service_name)(increase(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service), ', span_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_span_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']) / increase(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service), ', span_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_span_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), '])))'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time
